title: Semester Survival
description: Eight semesters. One degree. Build a life, make friends, survive deadlines and find your own path through university.

maker.name: Joseph Ombati & Antigravity
maker.bio: Semester Survival began as an idea from Joseph Ombati: a university-life simulation about the funny, stressful and unforgettable moments that shape a student. Built for players who know that making it to graduation is about more than passing exams. The game celebrates campus friendships, small wins, difficult choices and the everyday courage it takes to keep going.

credits.name: Joseph Ombati
credits.role: Original Concept, Game Design & Creative Direction

keyboard.Arrow Left / Right: Change between the three campus lanes

touch.Interact prompt: Tap when near a character or campus location

instructions: Run through the university campus. Swipe left or right on mobile to change lanes, swipe up to jump and swipe down to slide. On PC use the arrow keys: left/right to change lanes, up to jump and down to slide. Press E or Space to interact when near a character or campus location. Balance your energy, hunger, focus and stress, complete assignments, build friendships and graduate after eight semesters.
